evidence_discipline: Cross-compilation, mocks, ignored tests and startup alone do not establish runtime support. Only native-tested configurations may be listed as supported. Never delete evidence to support a claim.

rejected.reason: Kbox Box on macOS requires Apple Silicon; Intel Macs are not supported.

CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION ONLY: host_check.rs rejects non-x86_64 Windows and libkrun has no aarch64 WHPX backend. The product requirement has been raised to must-support, so this rejection is scheduled to be lifted, not permanent.
Only macOS (Apple Silicon), Linux with KVM and Windows with WHPX are admitted.
Box requires a dedicated MicroVM; shared-host-kernel containers are not a Box product path.

known_gaps: The guest runtime catalog (krun/runtime/base/runtime-catalog.cjs) does not collect Python identity despite the architecture baseline naming Python 3.11.
libkrun main is 2.0 and explicitly not backwards compatible with the 1.x API/ABI; kbox pins libkrun 1.17.0 and a forked libkrunfw v5.3.0 with fixed SHA-256.
No built-in driver currently reaches 'supported'; fresh-host evidence for WHPX and Linux KVM is the remaining gate.
